title: Wrapped Confirmed-Error-PDU after request
purpose: Replace the bare confirmed-error fragment with a paired sequence so the error branch is reached after a prior confirmed request.
expected_behavior: The target should parse the initial confirmed request for service [77] FileDirectory and then route the reply into Confirmed-Error-PDU processing.
constraints_preserved: Request uses documented MMS Confirmed-Request-PDU tag 0xa0 and confirmed service [77] FileDirectory.
Response uses documented MMS tag 0xa2 Confirmed-Error-PDU.
ACSE wrapper bytes use documented accepted types 0x60 and 0x61.
Nested lengths are definite and internally consistent.
issue_safety_notes: This sequence intentionally uses a safe structural error analogue and does not claim any known fault trigger.
